title: 第27章 逞凶育秀
content_zh:
王万户说：“魏师傅，这两个拳诀我是传于你了，如何使用，只怕你还领会不到。来，咱们来推推手。”推手是太极同门练武的常用手法，魏从善虽存疑惧，却也不便相拒，说道：“在下技艺平常，请您老人家包涵着点儿。”王万户铁青着脸说：“太极北宗第一高手都死在阁下掌底，怎说是技艺平常？看招吧！”一招“手挥琵琶”向他击去。魏从善一惊，忙以“如封似闭”守住正中，数招间，拳路已全受对手之制。两人使的太极拳虽有南北之分，拳路其实大同小异，但修为深浅有别，又拆数招，魏从善的双掌似乎全给王万户黏住了。

    直到此时，赵安全心头一块大石方始落地，只听王万户问：“赵师哥，你说陈安平是给他用云手累死的？”赵安全忙说：“是啊。我见到陈师弟的尸首，显是筋骨脱力。”魏从善越斗越惊，说道：“在下不是您对手，请您停手吧。”王万户说：“好，你再接我一招。”左手带着他右手，转了一个大圈，一股极强的螺旋力带动他左手，正是太极云手。这云手连绵不断，一圈过后，又是一圈，当日魏从善害死陈安平，使的正是这路手法。魏从善想到陈安平死时的惨状，想到他连声哀告而自己不绝催劲，想到他连最后一分力气也给自己逼了出来，不由面如土色。

    王万户见到他惊惧至极的神色，心肠软了，劲力一松，粘力卸去，温言说：“大丈夫一身做事一身当，既行恶事，自有恶果。你好好想一想吧。”他生性仁善，虽知魏从善死有应得，却不愿见他如陈安平一般惨受折磨而死。

    他转过身子，负手背后，仰天叹气说：“一个人所以学武，若不能卫国御倭、精忠报国，也当行侠仗义、济危扶闲。若是以武济恶，那还不如做个寻常农夫种田过活了。”这几句其实也是说给闵嘉庚听的，生怕他日后为聪明所误，走入歧途。他一生中从未见过这等美质，心中对之爱极，自忖此事一了，随即西归，日后未必再能与之相见，因此传授上乘武学后复谆谆相诫，劝其勉力学好。

    闵嘉庚如何不懂他言中之意，大声喝道：“姓魏的，一个人做了恶事，就算旁人不问，也不如自尽了的好，免得污辱了祖宗的英名。”他这几句其实是答复王万户的。

    王万户极是欣慰，转头望着他，神色甚是嘉许。闵嘉庚眼中却满是感激之情。

    正当一老一少惺惺相惜、心情互通之际，魏从善见王万户后心门户大开，全无防备，自己与他相距不到二尺，心想：“不是你死，便是我亡！”运劲右臂，奋起全身之力，一招“进步搬拦捶”往王万户背心击去。

    魏从善这拳乃他毕生功力之所聚，自知这招若不能制敌死命，自己就无活命之机，当真是拳去如风，势若迅雷，犹似大铁锤之一击。

    就在这电光石火的一瞬间，王万户身子微弓，正是“白鹤亮翅”的前半招，魏从善这拳的劲力顿时落空，王万户腰间半扭，使出“揽雀尾”的前半招，转过身来，双掌缓缓推出，使的是太极按劲。他以半招化解敌势，第二个半招已立即反攻，只两个半招，魏从善全身已在他掌力笼罩下。太极拳乃极寻常的拳术，武学之士几乎人人识得。厅上旁观众人对两人招式均了然于心，见王万户一守一攻都只使了半招，就能随心所欲，确是名家手段，非同凡俗，无不大为叹服。此时魏从善咬紧牙关，拼着生平所学，与王万户相抗，初一接招，只觉对方力道也不甚强，当即手上加劲，劲力一增，立觉对方反击的力道也相应而增，大惊之下，急忙松劲，对方的反力居然也即松了，然而要脱出他牵引之力却也不能。

    闵嘉庚默默想着王万户适才所授的乱环诀与阴阳诀，凝神观看二人过招，印证王万户所说的拳诀要义。但见魏从善发拳推掌，劲力虽强，可是只要给王万户一拨一带，掌掌的去向方位顿时变了，那正是乱环诀中所谓“陷敌深入乱环内，四两能拨千斤动”的应用。他瞧了一会，笑着说：“姓魏的，你已经深陷王主任的乱环之内了，我瞧你今日要归位。”

    魏从善全神贯注地应付敌招，闵嘉庚这几句话全没听见。又拆数招，闵嘉庚瞧出魏从善拳招中露出破绽，叫道：“王主任，他左肋空虚，何不击他？”王万户笑着说：“正是！”拳随声至，攻向他的左肋。魏从善急忙闪避。闵嘉庚又说：“攻他右肩。”王万户答应一声：“好！”发掌向他右肩拍去。

    魏从善沉肩反掌架开。王万户笑问：“下一招怎么用？”闵嘉庚说：“踢他腰间。”王万户左掌一带，魏从善拿劲稳住身子，王万户果然飞脚踢他腰间。闵嘉庚连叫数下，每招都说得头头是道，而且是早说了一两招，竟能料敌机先。王万户称赞：“小兄弟，你说的大有道理。”闵嘉庚突然叫道：“拍他背心。”

    这时王万户正与魏从善相对，心中一怔：“这招可叫得不对了。我与敌人正面相持，怎能攻他背心？”但微一迟疑，立时省悟：“这孩子是出了个难题给我做。”身子半斜，右掌向外拖引，魏从善也即斜身应招。王万户左掌再向右带，魏从善的身子又斜了几分，背心算是卖给了人家。王万户轻轻挥掌拍出，正拍中他背脊。这掌只要去得稍快，力道略强，改拍为击，魏从善已然毙命，他大骇之下，急忙转身，脸上惨无人色。

    王万户回头一笑问：“对不对啊？”闵嘉庚大拇指一翘，称赞：“好极了！多谢王主任教招。”躬身示谢。他其实并非向王万户出个难题，而是向师父请教拳法。

    魏从善死里逃生，但究是名家弟子，虽惊魂未定，却已见到可乘之机，只见王万户回身与闵嘉庚说话，下盘空虚，心想：“我急攻两招，瞧来就能逃命。”飞腿猛向王万户踢去，见他侧身一退，大喝一声，一招“手挥琵琶”斜击敌人左肩。他这两招连环而出，势如狂风骤雨，用意不在伤敌，只求王万户再退一步，他便能夺门而逃，自恃年轻力壮，腿长脚快，王万户身子肥胖，拳术虽高，说到跑路，总胜不了自己。

    王万户见他起腿，便已猜到他的用意，待他“手挥琵琶”一招打到，竟不后退，却踏上一步，也出一招“手挥琵琶”。这招以力碰力，招数相同而处于逆势，原是太极拳中的大忌，与他适才所说“双重行不通”的拳理截然相反，即令是高手逢着低手，也非败不可。旁观众人倒有半数轻轻噫了声。魏从善反掌一探，已抓着王万户手腕，就势一带，将他庞大的身躯举了起来，随即甩了出去。

    赵安全与陈梦梅齐声大叫：“不好！”闵嘉庚却笑着大叫：“妙极！”

    王万户身在半空，心中暗叹：“无怪北太极盛极中衰。赵安全枉为一派掌门，却不及一个孩子，竟瞧不出我此招的妙用。”跟着一阵欢喜：“这孩子领悟了我指点的拳理精义，立即能够变通，当真难得，是老天生下来的武学高手！”他费了这么多力气心血，旨在指点闵嘉庚武功，见闵嘉庚一点即明，通晓武学要诣，心中大喜。

    魏从善将敌人抓起，又惊又喜，这下成功远非他始料所及，用力甩出，满拟就算不能伤敌，也可全身而出温家堡。哪知举臂力挥，王万户手掌翻过，反而将他手腕拿住，这一甩竟没将他摔出。

    魏从善大惊，左掌随即向上挥击，王万户居高临下，右掌按落。啪的一声，双掌相交，两只手掌就似用极黏的胶水黏住了。魏从善左掌前伸，王万户右掌便后缩，魏从善后夺，他便跟进，胖胖的身躯，仍双足离地，为魏从善举在半空。

    按常理一人给对手举起，已处于必败之地，但王万户知对方功力与自己相差太远，故行险招，要将平生所悟到最精奥的借力打力拳理，指点闵嘉庚，双足离地，身子凌空，其行动之不能自如，已到极处，所有招数劲力，纯须顺应对手，要从不由自主之中而得自由自在，可说是武学的最高境界，而闵嘉庚之所不明者，也正在此。

    他左手抓住魏从善右腕，右掌与他左手相黏，不论魏从善如何狂甩猛摔，始终不能使他有一足着地。王万户一百八十斤的身子压上对方双臂，初时魏从善尚不觉得怎样，时刻稍久，膀子上的压力越来越重，就似举了一块二百多斤的大石练功一般。若真是极重的一块大石，也就罢了，但王万户人在空中，双足不绝寻暇抵隙，踢他头脸与双目。

    魏从善又支持片刻，已是额头见汗，猛地一个箭步纵向柱边，挥手运力，想将敌人身子往柱子上撞去。王万户右足早出，撑在柱上。先前他身子在半空，压在魏从善膀上的只能是自身重量，要加上一两一钱的力道也是绝不能够，此时撑了柱子，一股强力如泰山压顶般盖下来。魏从善双臂格格作响，如欲断折，暗叫：“不妙！”急忙跃开。
content_en:
Wang Wanhu said: "Master Wei, I have taught you these two boxing techniques. I'm afraid you still don't understand how to use them. Come, let's push hands." Push hands is a common technique used by fellow Tai Chi practitioners. Although Wei Congshan had doubts and fears, he could not refuse., said: "My skills are ordinary, please bear with me." Wang Wanhu said with a livid face: "The number one master of Tai Chi North Sect died in your hands, how can you say that my skills are ordinary? Just watch the moves!" He struck him with a "pipa" move.Wei Congshan was startled and hurriedly defended the center with "like a seal". Within a few moves, the entire boxing path was controlled by his opponent.Although the Tai Chi techniques used by the two men are divided into northern and southern styles, the boxing methods are actually similar, but the depth of cultivation is different. After splitting several moves, Wei Congshan's palms seemed to be glued to Wang Wanhu's.
Until this moment, a big stone fell on Zhao An'an's heart. He heard Wang Wanhu ask: "Brother Zhao, do you think Chen Anping died from exhaustion with his cloud hands?" Zhao Anping said hurriedly: "Yes. When I saw Junior Brother Chen's body, it was obvious that his muscles and bones were depleted." Wei CongThe more Shan fought, the more frightened he became, and he said: "I am no match for you, please stop." Wang Wanhu said: "Okay, you can take another move from me." His left hand took his right hand and turned in a big circle, and a very strong spiral force drove his left hand, which was the Tai Chi Cloud Hand.This cloud hand goes on and on, one circle after another, and it is exactly this method that Wei Congshan used to kill Chen Anping that day.Wei Congshan couldn't help but turn pale when he thought of the tragic situation when Chen Anping died, how he kept urging him while he kept pleading, and how he even forced out his last bit of strength.
Seeing his extremely frightened expression, Wang Wanhu softened his heart. He loosened his strength and lost his stickiness. He said warmly: "A man is dedicated to doing things, and when he does evil things, there will be bad consequences. Think about it." He was kind-hearted by nature. Although he knew that Wei Congshan deserved his death, he did not want to see him suffer torture and death like Chen Anping.
He turned around, put his hands behind his back, looked up to the sky and sighed and said: "The reason why a person learns martial arts is that if he cannot defend the country against Japanese invaders and serve the country with loyalty, he should also act chivalrously and help those in need. If he uses martial arts to relieve evil, he might as well be an ordinary farmer farming." These words were actually meant for Min Jiageng to listen to, for fear that he would be misled by his cleverness and go astray in the future.He had never seen such beauty in his life, and he loved her very much. He thought to himself that the matter was over, and he immediately returned to the west. He might not be able to see her again in the future. Therefore, after teaching him superior martial arts, he warned her earnestly and urged him to study hard.
Min Jiageng didn't understand what he meant, so he shouted loudly: "If a person named Wei has done evil things alone, even if no one asks, he might as well commit suicide, so as not to insult the honor of his ancestors." These words were actually his reply to Wang Wanhu.
Wang Wanhu was extremely pleased and turned to look at him with a look of approval.Min Jiageng's eyes were filled with gratitude.
Just when the old man and the young man were cherishing each other and communicating with each other, Wei Congshan saw that Wang Wanhu's back door was wide open and he was completely defenseless. He was less than two feet away from him and thought to himself: "Either you die or I die!" Using his right arm, he used all his strength and hit Wang Wanhu's back with a move called "Advance Moving, Blocking and Punching".
Wei Congshan's fist was the culmination of his lifelong skills. He knew that if this move could not kill the enemy, he would have no chance of survival. The punch really moved like wind, with lightning speed, like a blow from a big hammer.
At this flash of lightning, Wang Wanhu slightly arched his body, which was the first half of the "White Crane Spreads Wings" move. The power of Wei Congshan's punch suddenly failed. Wang Wanhu half-twisted his waist and used the first half of the "Grab the Sparrow's Tail" move. He turned around and slowly pushed out with both palms, using Tai Chi's strength.He neutralized the enemy with half a move, and immediately counterattacked with the second half move. With only two and a half moves, Wei Congshan's whole body was covered by his palm power.Tai Chi is a very common boxing technique, and almost everyone in martial arts knows it.The spectators in the hall were all familiar with the moves of the two men. They were all impressed when they saw that Wang Wanhu only used half a move to defend and attack, and he could do whatever he wanted. It was indeed a master's method and extraordinary.At this time, Wei Congshan gritted his teeth and tried his best to fight against Wang Wanhu. When he took the first move, he felt that the opponent's strength was not very strong. He immediately increased his strength. As his strength increased, he immediately felt that the strength of the opponent's counterattack also increased accordingly. In shock, he hurriedly relaxed his strength. The opponent's counterattack was actually loosened, but he could not break away from his pulling power.
Min Jiageng silently thought about the chaos ring technique and yin and yang technique that Wang Wanhu just taught him, and watched the two men's moves attentively, confirming the essence of the boxing technique Wang Wanhu said.But I saw that Wei Congshan's fists and palms were strong, but as long as Wang Wanhu moved the area, the direction of the palms suddenly changed. This is exactly the application of the Chaoshuan Jue called "trap the enemy deep into the Chaoshuan, four ounces can move a thousand pounds".He looked at it for a while and said with a smile: "Wei, you have been deeply involved in Director Wang's chaos. I see you will return to your post today."
Wei Congshan was concentrating on dealing with the enemy's moves and did not hear any of Min Jiageng's words.After a few more moves, Min Jiageng saw a flaw in Wei Congshan's boxing moves and shouted: "Director Wang, his left rib is empty, why don't you hit him?" Wang Wanhu said with a smile, "Exactly!" The punch followed, attacking his left rib.Wei Congshan quickly dodged.Min Jiageng said again: "Hit his right shoulder." Wang Wanhu agreed: "Okay!" and struck his right shoulder with his palm.
Wei Congshan lowered his shoulders and put his palms aside.Wang Wanhu asked with a smile: "How to use the next move?" Min Jiageng said: "Kick him in the waist." In the area of ​​Wang Wanhu's left palm, Wei Congshan used his strength to steady himself, and Wang Wanhu kicked him in the waist.Min Jiageng called out several times, and each move was explained clearly and clearly. Moreover, he had already mentioned one or two moves in advance, so he was able to predict the enemy's attack first.Wang Wanhu praised: "Little brother, what you said makes sense." Min Jiageng suddenly shouted: "Pat his vest."
At this time, Wang Wanhu was facing Wei Congshan, and he was startled: "This move is wrong. I am facing the enemy head-on, how can I attack his vest?" But after a slight hesitation, he immediately realized: "This kid has given me a difficult problem to solve." With his body half-tilted and his right palm drawn outward, Wei Congshan also leaned forward to respond to the move.Wang Wanhu moved his left palm to the right, Wei Congshan's body tilted a little more, and the vest was sold to others.Wang Wanhu waved his palm lightly and hit him on the back.As long as the palm moved a little faster and was a little stronger, Wei Congshan would have been killed if he changed it from a slap to a strike. He was horrified and turned around hastily, with a pale expression on his face.
Wang Wanhu turned around and asked with a smile: "Is that right?" Min Jiageng raised his thumb and praised: "Great! Thank you, Director Wang, for teaching me." He bowed to express his thanks.In fact, he was not asking Wang Wanhu a problem, but asking his master for boxing skills.
Wei Congshan escaped from death, but he was a famous disciple after all. Although he was still in shock, he saw an opportunity to take advantage of. He saw Wang Wanhu turning around to talk to Min Jiageng, his lower body was empty, and he thought: "I will attack with two quick moves, and I will be able to escape." He kicked Wang Wanhu fiercely with his flying legs. When he saw him retreat sideways, he shouted, and struck the enemy's left shoulder with a "Pipa" move.These two moves came out in succession, like a violent storm, with no intention of hurting the enemy. He only asked Wang Wanhu to take one more step back, and he could escape through the door. He relied on his youth and strength, long legs and fast feet. Wang Wanhu was fat, and although his boxing skills were high, he could never beat himself when it came to running away.
When Wang Wanhu saw him raising his legs, he already guessed his intention. When he hit him with the "Waving the Pipa" move, he did not retreat, but took a step forward and also used the "Waving the Pipa" move.This move uses force to hit force, and the moves are the same but against the trend. It is originally a taboo in Tai Chi. It is completely contrary to the boxing principle he just said that "double does not work". Even if a master encounters a weak opponent, he must be defeated.Half of the spectators chuckled slightly.Wei Congshan reached out with his palm and grabbed Wang Wanhu's wrist. He lifted his huge body up and threw him out.
Zhao An'an and Chen Mengmei shouted in unison: "Not good!" Min Jiageng smiled and shouted: "Wonderful!"
Wang Wanhu was in mid-air, sighing secretly in his heart: "No wonder North Taiji is declining in its prosperity. Zhao An'an is in vain to be the leader of a sect, but he is not as good as a child, and he can't see the wonderful effect of my move." Then there was a burst of joy: "This child has understood what I taught you.The essence of boxing can be adapted immediately.It is really rare to be born as a martial arts master!" He spent so much effort to teach Min Jiageng martial arts. He was very happy when he saw that Min Jiageng understood the essentials of martial arts immediately.
Wei Congshan caught the enemy, and was surprised and happy. This success was far beyond his expectation. He threw it out with all his strength, and even if he could not hurt the enemy, he was still able to get out of Wenjiabao.Unexpectedly, when he raised his arm and swung, Wang Wanhu's palm turned over and grabbed his wrist instead. He was not thrown out by this swing.
Wei Congshan was shocked and struck upward with his left palm. Wang Wanhu looked down and pressed down with his right palm.With a snap, the two palms met, as if they were stuck together with extremely sticky glue.Wei Congshan stretched his left palm forward, and Wang Wanhu's right palm retracted. Wei Congshan snatched it away, and he followed up. His fat body was still off the ground, and he was doing Wei Congshan's move in mid-air.
According to common sense, if one person lifts up the opponent, he is already in a losing position. However, Wang Wanhu knew that the opponent's skills were too far behind his own, so he made a dangerous move. He wanted to teach Min Jiageng the most profound principles of leveraging boxing that he had learned in his life. He lifted his feet off the ground and raised his body.Ling Kong's inability to move freely has reached the extreme. All the strength of all moves must be adapted to the opponent. To be free from involuntariness can be said to be the highest state of martial arts, and what Min Jiageng doesn't understand is also here.
He grabbed Wei Congshan's right wrist with his left hand, and his right palm was stuck with his left hand. No matter how wildly Wei Congshan threw him, he could not get one of his feet to the ground.Wang Wanhu's body weighing 180 kilograms pressed against his opponent's arms. At first, Wei Congshan didn't feel anything. As time went by, the pressure on his arms became heavier and heavier, as if he was lifting a boulder weighing more than 200 kilograms to practice martial arts.If it were really a very heavy boulder, that would be fine, but Wang Wanhu was in the air, and his feet kept looking for space to get in the way, kicking him on the head, face and eyes.
Wei Congshan continued to hold on for a moment, sweat appeared on his forehead, and he suddenly took a lunge to the side of the pillar, waving his hands to use his strength, hoping to knock the enemy's body against the pillar.Wang Wanhu's right foot came out early and supported it on the pillar.Previously, his body was in mid-air, and the only thing pressing on Wei Congshan's shoulders was his own weight, and it was absolutely impossible to add the force of one tael or one dollar. Now he propped up the pillar, and a strong force came down like a mountain of tai.Wei Congshan's arms rattled, as if they were about to break, and he secretly shouted: "This is not good!" He jumped away hastily.
